name: session-ended-unexpectedly

graded_by.test: core/internal/worker/manager_test.go — SIGKILL the echo worker mid-stream: the session reads terminated, attached clients are closed 4012, the audit ends it terminated/worker_lost, and its recording ends in a terminated marker

description: The end from outside TSB (session model §12–§13). When a session's worker dies the session cannot continue (immortality §1.1, §3): its record reads terminated, attached clients are closed with WebSocket code 4012 session_terminated, the audit's end event says terminated / worker_lost, and the recording is finalized with a terminated end marker. The target closing the session (target_closed) and a lost connection (connection_lost) end it the same way, graded from artefacts (C3 ends-from-outside); killed, the end by TSB or through it, is proved live by session-delete. There is no disconnected state. No REST call can kill a worker, so the core's own test grades this at e0; from e1 the harness's worker-death rig proves the audit and the recording from a real run (C8 worker-death-recorded).
